items.name: One night, while I was falling asleep, I heard in my mind (!) this synth tune. It was a short polyphonic piece played with a quality synth.
I didn't want to forget it, so I quickly turned on my Amy and wrote it down with AHX. This tune is a nearly exact transposition of the dream, even the tuning is correct.
Althought it's nothing special, musically speaking, it's really interesting because of its origin.
I hope that more tunes like this will follow, and hope they will be longer and more elaborated. This is the reason I have numbered it "1".
N e c t a r i n e
